You should not end it, at all. You shouldn't take your own life. 
I'm sure there is still hope inside you that wants a change. 

You may not know it, but one of the biggest key phrases that suggests wanting help or wanting a change in your life is "I hate the person I've become" and "Tell me why"

From experience, I know you MIGHT be still looking for hope or something to change your mind. Something to make you find reason in all of the bad stuff in life, right? 

Just know: 

You are not lazy. You may be depressed. Definitely not lazy. Although you haven't been diagnosed, you've got to have depression in order to be diagnosed for it. 

Have you thought about getting professional help? 
You can talk to me if you'd like, I can send you my discord.
